source.publication: 2025 Complete Income Tax Instruction Booklet (ip25), Kansas Department of Revenue, with Form K-40 and Schedule S bound in (PDF pages 19-22)
source.section: Form K-40 lines 1-12 (ip25 PDF page 20; exemption block PDF page 19); K-40 instructions lines 1-3 (PDF page 6), line 4 and exemptions (PDF page 6), lines 5-8 (PDF page 7); Schedule S line A1 (ip25 PDF page 21), instructions PDF page 11; tax rate schedule: 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 34) and Tax Table (PDF pages 27-34)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 60,000.00 = 60,000.00 (municipal interest is not in federal AGI). Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 (15,750.00) = 44,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Kansas starts from federal AGI). Schedule S Part A: line A1 state and municipal interest not exempt in Kansas 3,000.00 (other states' bonds); lines A2-A8 0.00; line A9 total additions 3,000.00. Line A10 0.00; lines A11-A13 0.00; line A14 0.00; lines A15-A25 0.00; line A26 total subtractions = 0.00; line A27 net modification = 3,000.00 - 0.00 = 3,000.00. Form K-40: line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 modifications 3,000.00; line 3 Kansas AGI = 60,000.00 + (3,000.00) = 63,000.00; line 4 standard deduction (single) 3,605.00; line 5 exemption allowance (1 exemption) 9,160.00, 0 dependents; line 6 total deductions = 3,605.00 + 9,160.00 = 12,765.00; line 7 taxable income = 63,000.00 - 12,765.00 = 50,235.00; line 8 tax (rate schedule as numbers, PDF page 34): 5.2% x 23,000.00 = 1,196.00 + 5.58% x (50,235.00 - 23,000.00 = 27,235.00) = 1,519.7130; total 2,715.7130 = 2,715.71. Line 7 is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 50,201-50,250, single, head of household or married filing separate column, PDF page 30, gives 2,715; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 9-10 do not apply (resident); line 11 0.00; line 12 total income tax 2,715.71. Credits (lines 13-15, 17): none, 0.00; state income tax = 2,715.71. The 2,000.00 of Kansas municipal interest is in neither federal AGI nor line A1 (taken as obligations issued after 12/31/87).
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rates, not the printed tables and rounded worksheet subtraction.
